**[[2022 Russian invasion of Ukraine]]
***[[Southern Ukraine campaign]]
****[[Ukraine]] says that the [[Zaporizhzhia Nuclear Power Plant]] has been completely disconnected from its power grid after shelling near the [[Russian occupation of Zaporizhzhia Oblast|Russian-occupied]] plant caused several fires. Security systems at the plant were activated shortly after the power failure, according to a local official. '''Law and crime'''
*[[Assassination of Shinzo Abe]]
**[[Itaru Nakamura]], chief of the [[National Police Agency (Japan)|Japanese national police agency]], resigns, taking responsibility for the failures in former [[Prime Minister of Japan|prime minister]] [[Shinzo Abe]]'s security that resulted in his assassination in [[Nara (city)|Nara]] on July 8. [https://www.cbc.ca/news/world/japan-national-police-chief-resigns-shinzo-abe-assassination-1.6561567 (CBC)]
